comment: The LIMR is described as constraining “uncontrolled local variation.” Local variation is not inherently undesirable and may be clinically or culturally necessary. The problem is undocumented or non-interoperable variation.

anchor.note: p.67 l.Lines 664-666 read as the printed page; section 3.5.3.1 agrees

public.text: The LIMR is described as constraining “uncontrolled local variation.” Local variation is not inherently undesirable and may be clinically or culturally necessary. The problem is undocumented or non-interoperable variation.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with sentence like: “governs necessary national and local variation through explicit extensions, constraints, mappings, versioning, and conformance rules.”
